item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President establishes an internal executive task force; this is executive organization rather than a change to legal rights or a dictated agency legal outcome.","evidence":"I am establishing a Presidential Task Force on Global Resources and Environment."},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President assigns membership, leadership, assessment, consultation, and reporting responsibilities within the executive branch, all of which are internal management functions.","evidence":"The Task Force will report to me within six months and periodically thereafter on its progress"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the Task Force to coordinate, prioritize attention, and assess federal efforts and analytical capacity, without prescribing a legally consequential result.","evidence":"I have directed the Task Force to work closely with you in carrying out its responsibilities"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"Agencies must support the Task Force, which must make recommendations and progress reports; these are internal cooperation and reporting duties, with no specified legal consequence.","evidence":"Each of your agencies shall cooperate with and support this important Task Force."}]}
